_source: Clardentity 25-role user psyche classification (client diagrams, 2026-08-05). Each role is a standing relationship or position a person occupies. Qualifiers marked exclusive:true admit exactly one value; the rest may take several.

roles.label: Member of a family
roles.description: As a member of a family.

roles.label: Child of a parent
roles.description: As an adolescent or adult child of a biological, step, adopted, foster, or in-law parent.

roles.label: Sibling
roles.description: As a sibling (younger, elder, half, step, or adoptive brother or sister).

roles.label: Cousin
roles.description: As a cousin (maternal, paternal, or adoptive younger or elder brother/sister).

roles.label: Nibling (niece or nephew)
roles.description: As a nibling (maternal, paternal, or adoptive younger or elder niece/nephew).

roles.label: Pibling (aunt or uncle)
roles.description: As a pibling (maternal, paternal, or adoptive aunt/uncle).

roles.label: Friend
roles.description: As a friend.

roles.label: Citizen of this world
roles.description: As a citizen of this world.

roles.label: Citizen of a country
roles.description: As a citizen of a country.

roles.label: Member of a community
roles.description: As a member of the community, neighbourhood, or locality.

roles.label: Student
roles.description: As a student.

roles.label: Dependent adolescent or adult
roles.description: As a dependent adolescent or adult.

roles.label: Independent adolescent or adult
roles.description: As an independent adolescent or adult.

roles.label: Unemployed adolescent or adult
roles.description: As an unemployed adolescent or adult.

roles.label: Employed adolescent or adult
roles.description: As an employed adolescent or adult: self-employed worker, business or enterprise owner, social worker, salaried political party worker or independent politician, or an employee of a government, private, corporate, NGO, or semi-government sector establishment, performing the responsibilities of an independent contributor or team leader.

roles.label: Partner
roles.description: As a partner: romantic partner, live-in partner, spouse, divorced individual, colleague, coworker, school/classmate, teammate, or business partner.

roles.label: Ex-partner
roles.description: As an ex-partner: ex-romantic partner, ex-live-in partner, ex-spouse, ex-colleague, ex-coworker, ex-school/classmate, ex-teammate, or ex-business partner.

roles.label: In-law
roles.description: As an in-law (parent, child, sibling, cousin, nibling, or pibling).

roles.label: Ex-in-law
roles.description: As an ex-in-law (parent, child, sibling, cousin, nibling, or pibling).

roles.label: Parent or guardian
roles.description: As a parent or guardian (biological, adoptive, foster, step, grandparent, in-law, or caregiver).

roles.label: Ex-friend
roles.description: As an ex-friend.

roles.label: Ex-citizen of a country
roles.description: As an ex-citizen of a country.

roles.label: Ex-member of a community
roles.description: As an ex-member of the community, neighbourhood, or locality.

roles.label: Ex-employee or worker
roles.description: As an ex-employee or worker.

roles.label: Ex-member of a family
roles.description: As an ex-member of a family.
